tagline.en: Every remaining game now has its own themed stage.
tagline.id: Semua game lainnya sekarang punya panggung bertema sendiri.

items.en: Crash flies through deep space past a ringed planet. Mines is a crystal cave. Limbo streaks through the stars.
items.id: Crash terbang di luar angkasa melewati planet bercincin. Mines jadi gua kristal. Limbo melesat di antara bintang.

items.en: Dice, Roulette and Blackjack sit on green felt with a gold rim. Coinflip has a velvet spotlight, Plinko a lit cabinet.
items.id: Dice, Roulette, dan Blackjack di atas meja hijau berbingkai emas. Coinflip disorot lampu di atas beludru, Plinko punya kabinet bercahaya.

items.en: Cases open in a vault, Case Battle on red felt, Chess on a wooden board, and each arcade game has its own backdrop.
items.id: Case dibuka di brankas, Case Battle di meja merah, Catur di papan kayu, dan tiap game arkade punya latar sendiri.
